Sofia, the discount is **10%**. Bettina's November 17 message in this channel first said 12%, then retracted it and said "it's 10%." The signed Amendment 1 (executed 2025-10-20, effective 2025-11-01) grants a 10% retention discount on Pemberline Dock per-seat charges, and the 2026 renewal order form carries that 10% over unchanged.

For the renewal brief, Bettina is the current owner of Saltmarsh, and June Osei-Lark on the deal desk signed the amendment and the renewal order form. Either of them can confirm the figure against the signed paperwork.
